mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the unemployment rate above 5% for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings expectations for S&P 500 constituents and drives negative forward returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 2% signals deteriorating demand, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when RSAFS YoY growth < -2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the industrial production index above 0.5% signals improving manufacturing activity, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when INDPRO > 0.5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both the federal funds rate and CPI above their respective 12-month averages signals a tightening monetary regime, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL exceed their 12-month averages (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both the unemployment rate above 5% and a decline in nonfarm payrolls below their 12-month average signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 5% and PAYEMS < 12mo avg (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the housing starts index above 5% signals strengthening residential demand, which boosts construction-related earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when HOUST > 5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below its 12-month average signals deteriorating demand, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when RSAFS < 12mo avg for three months (t-test p > 0.05).
